events.what_it_is: TEMPTATIONS' first Cat Bodega, a free immersive NYC pop-up celebrating bodega and shop cats with interactive displays, games and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Free admission, TEMPTATIONS cat-treat samples, and opportunities to win Cat Bodega merchandise through games including a claw machine and scratch-offs.
events.caveats: The physical NYC pop-up ends September 19; the separate virtual Cat Bodega continues through September 26. Free treats and prize merchandise are promotional and may be subject to availability.
events.practical_notes: Official TEMPTATIONS and Mars sources both state the NYC pop-up runs September 17–19, 12–6 PM daily at 213 Bowery. No advance RSVP or purchase requirement is published for the physical pop-up.

occurrences.details: Final day of the physical NYC Cat Bodega. Walk in for the free interactive experience, cat-treat samples and promotional games/prizes while available.
